_comment: Exact regression counts are HARD validation gates only for source versions that are still the validated pilot source. 1R76W8LI edition 78 was replaced by official edition 80 on 2026-07-21 with a different SHA-256, so its old edition-78 count fixture is intentionally retired; the new edition must pass all universal safety invariants and may receive a new version-bound fixture only after deliberate validation. 1R7788RI remains byte-identical to the validated pilot source and therefore retains its hard count fixture.
